description: Held-out generalisation probe. These are casual, indirect phrasings of the kind a real new joiner would type, written to be answered by the same knowledge sources as the main set but deliberately NOT used to tune the classifier. Reported separately from the main labelled set so the headline accuracy is not mistaken for generalisation.
purpose: The main question set was authored alongside the routing rules, so its accuracy is an upper bound. This probe is scored once, untuned, to give an honest signal.
